name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-12-22, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.68 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
